description: AGI-layer engine for goal setting, task prioritization, strategic planning, and ambition calibration. Determines what the system should pursue next, balances short-term vs long-term goals, and manages resource allocation for maximum impact.

/health.description: Engine health check with doctrine count, cache stats, and metrics

/query.description: Main query endpoint — 3-layer pipeline: doctrine cache -> semantic -> deep analysis

/analyze.description: Force deep analysis mode with DEFENSE-level output

/doctrines.description: List all 55+ doctrine blocks with metadata

/coverage.description: Coverage map showing triggered doctrines and knowledge gaps

/metrics.description: Performance telemetry: latency percentiles, cache hit rates, error rates

/prioritize.description: Run priority matrix analysis on a set of goals/tasks

/decompose.description: Decompose a high-level goal into actionable sub-tasks with dependencies

/roadmap.description: Generate strategic roadmap with milestones and critical path
